This was the batch's flagged 'highest-value duplicate suspect' (P2707 and P7537 share an identical Cyrillic base name, near-identical recorded length, and the same route corridor). Resolved NOT a duplicate: the Nov 2024 Government of Russia decree (3302-r) lists 'Ukhta - Torzhok. III нитка (Ямал)' (item 10, =P2707) and 'Ukhta - Torzhok. IV нитка (Ямал)' (item 13, =P7537) as two SEPARATE designated projects in the same list, exactly analogous to how the same decree lists 'Bovanenkovo-Ukhta. III нитка' and 'Bovanenkovo-Ukhta. IV нитка' as two distinct projects. 'нитка' (string/line) is standard Russian gas-industry terminology for a parallel additional trunk built alongside an existing corridor -- both being real, separately tracked lines within one physical corridor is expected and correct, not evidence of duplication.
